ryOS CrossMux **1.5.2** is a fork performance release on top of upstream CrossMux 1.5.1. It keeps multi-SKU CJK (TC/SC/JA/KO), GenSen, vertical EPUB, and WeRead on SC+TC.

## Highlights

- Async e-ink refresh: `GfxRenderer` defers wait via HAL, then overlaps grayscale AA with the BW waveform (whole-plane dual buffer when heap allows; dual-strip `GRAYSCALE_DUAL` fallback on low RAM).
- Incremental/partial EPUB `Section` builds: first page shows immediately; remainder continues in the reader loop; teardown can persist a partial sentinel.
- Chapter HTML cache under `html/` so reopen/rebuild skips unzip inflate when possible.
- JA/KO firmware compiles when upstream keyboard layout omits FR/DE/ES on CJK SKUs.

## Upgrade notes

- Existing books and reading progress are preserved.
- Finalized section cache versions are unchanged vs 1.5.1 (Latin 56 / TC 85 / SC 86 / JA 87 / KO 88). Partial `.part` sentinels and `html/` are new cache artifacts; stale caches rebuild automatically.
- Simulator always uses the blocking refresh path. Device waveform overlap needs hardware to verify.

> **WeRead security notice:** WeRead uses an unofficial web protocol that may change without notice. Device traffic is encrypted with wolfSSL, but the current client does not verify the server CA or host identity. Use WeRead only on a trusted network.

## Firmware assets

- `firmware.bin` — international
- `firmware-tc.bin` — Traditional Chinese (`1.5.2-tc`)
- `firmware-sc.bin` — Simplified Chinese
- `firmware-ja.bin` — Japanese
- `firmware-ko.bin` — Korean
- `bootloader.bin` and `partitions.bin` — USB/web flashing

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ryokun6/crossmux/compare/1.5.1...1.5.2
